decisive_items: Physical examination revealed dozens of skin-colored dome-shaped papules over the chin, nasal, and perinasal regions of the face
Dental examination showed several teeth with a conical shape
Electron micrograph shows a dermal fibroblast with prominent crystalline inclusions within the cytoplasm
response.rationale: R2 uniquely captures the full TSC phenotype: angiofibromas, conical teeth, and the pathognomonic electron-microscopic crystalline inclusions. C1 is an append-only completion of R2 but adds no new raw evidence since R2 already includes the conical teeth span. R5, R6, and R1 are contradicted by the absence of hypopigmented macules and other features, and lack the specific EM finding.

rejected.why: Contradicted by absence of hypopigmented macules and other characteristic features; no EM crystals.
No supporting raw spans; contradicted by absence of characteristic skin lesions.
Contradicted by absence of hypopigmented macules; lacks conical teeth and EM crystals.
Redundant append-only completion of R2; adds no new raw evidence beyond R2's existing spans.
